title: Join a list with a separator
description: Write a function `join_with_hash(items)` that joins a list of strings with `' # '` between each pair.
hints: The separator string can be anything, not just a single space - ' # '.join(items) uses the 3-character string ' # ' between every pair of items.
expected_behavior: Returns the items joined with ' # ' between each pair.
explanation: join()'s separator is whatever string it's called on - ' # ' works exactly like ' ' did earlier, just with a longer separator.
